gaps.normative_requirement: The supplied particular part specifies safety requirements for pumps.
gaps.finding_reason: The declared model is SPC55068, but the testing summary identifies 4TSC4.0-96-110/1000 as the model fully tested; no relationship between the models is established.
gaps.required_action: Identify the tested sample and provide a report covering SPC55068 or substantiated evidence establishing applicability of the tests.

gaps.normative_requirement: The applicable rated-voltage marking requirement is in Part 1, which was not supplied.
gaps.finding_reason: The declared rating is 220–240 V, whereas the clause 7.1 entry records 96 V; the supply is also identified as DC despite the 50 Hz declared rating.
gaps.required_action: Correct the product rating and supply identification using verified sample and marking evidence.

gaps.normative_requirement: The applicable power-input assessment requirement is in Part 1, which was not supplied.
gaps.finding_reason: The declared rated input is 550 W, but the test table uses 1,000 W and reports 995.2 W at 72 V; the result cannot establish compliance for the declared rating.
gaps.required_action: Provide a valid power-input assessment for the identified 550 W model and its applicable supply.

gaps.normative_requirement: The supplied particular part applies the corresponding Part 1 safety tests, with its stated modifications.
gaps.finding_reason: Heating and leakage-current tables use 76.3 V, and the locked-rotor table uses 116.6 V DC, inconsistent with the declared 220–240 V, 50 Hz rating.
gaps.required_action: Verify the tested sample and repeat or substantiate the applicable tests at the correct supply conditions.

gaps.normative_requirement: The supplied European particular part endorses IEC 60335-2-41:2012 and is read with its identified European amendment.
gaps.finding_reason: The test specification cites IEC 60335-2-41:2025, while the compliance summary cites IEC 60335-2-41:2012; the actual assessment basis is unresolved.
gaps.required_action: Confirm the edition used and provide the applicable Part 1 and A11 amendment for a complete assessment.

gaps.normative_requirement: Pumps are tested as portable unless fixed, and portable pumps other than the stated exceptions undergo the cord-flexing test.
gaps.finding_reason: Both provisions are marked N/A without establishing that the pump is fixed; the portable and fixed selections are not identified, although a fixed-appliance cord anchorage test is recorded.
gaps.required_action: Establish whether the pump is fixed and perform the applicable portable-appliance and cord-flexing assessment.

gaps.normative_requirement: A submersible pump rated above 50 W must be marked with its maximum operating depth, with a minimum of 1 m.
gaps.finding_reason: The declared 550 W submersible pump has maximum operating depth recorded as N/A, and the corresponding marking provision is also marked N/A.
gaps.required_action: Establish and verify the maximum operating depth marking on the tested model.

gaps.normative_requirement: Pumps must be marked with maximum liquid temperature, and the liquid temperature must be maintained as specified during testing.
gaps.finding_reason: The report refers to the marking plate and states only a maximum liquid temperature below 45 °C; the reproduced plate does not show an exact temperature and the actual test-liquid temperature is not recorded.
gaps.required_action: Provide the verified temperature marking and actual liquid temperatures used for the applicable tests.

gaps.normative_requirement: Installation instructions for pumps rated above 50 W must state the maximum total head in metres.
gaps.finding_reason: The report gives a pass and refers to marking detail, but no maximum total-head value or supporting installation instruction is provided.
gaps.required_action: Provide the installation instructions and verify the maximum total-head value for SPC55068.

gaps.normative_requirement: The specified normal-operation head must achieve the highest power input, and the dry-running test must use approximately half maximum total head at rated voltage.
gaps.finding_reason: The report gives a pass for the dry-running sequence but records neither the actual total head nor the applied voltage for that sequence; normal-operation hydraulic conditions are also not substantiated.
gaps.required_action: Provide the measured head, supply and operating records for normal operation and the complete dry-running sequence.

gaps.normative_requirement: Submersible pumps undergo the specified 24 h immersion and depth-dependent water-pressure test.
gaps.finding_reason: A pass is recorded without the maximum operating depth, actual pressure, water temperature or salinity; the report also refers to 5 m rather than the supplied standard’s 15 m alternative.
gaps.required_action: Establish the marked depth and provide or repeat the immersion test with all required conditions recorded.

gaps.normative_requirement: Level switches are subjected to 50,000 operating cycles.
gaps.finding_reason: The level-switch test is marked N/A, while the overview image appears to show a float-operated device; the report does not resolve whether it is a level switch fitted to the tested sample.
gaps.required_action: Identify the device in the overview and provide the applicable level-switch assessment or a substantiated exclusion.

gaps.normative_requirement: Submersible pumps other than class III must have a flexible supply cord fitted with a plug.
gaps.finding_reason: The particular-part cord and plug provisions are marked N/A for the declared class I submersible pump; the general plug entry is marked pass, leaving the record contradictory.
gaps.required_action: Verify and document the fitted flexible cord and plug and correct both particular-part verdicts.

gaps.normative_requirement: Outdoor pumps other than class III require the specified polychloroprene or equivalent cord, subject to the stated exceptions.
gaps.finding_reason: Outdoor use is selected, but the report addresses an indoor-cord provision and provides no cord designation or assessment against the supplied outdoor requirement.
gaps.required_action: Identify the supply cord and assess it against the applicable outdoor-pump requirement.

gaps.normative_requirement: The outdoor submersible pump cord must be at least 10 m or 3 m longer than the marked maximum operating depth, whichever is greater.
gaps.finding_reason: The applicable outdoor cord-length provision is marked N/A, with neither cord length nor operating depth recorded.
gaps.required_action: Measure the cord and establish the marked operating depth before assessing the required minimum length.

gaps.normative_requirement: The specified fire-resistance provision applies according to the pump enclosure and RCD-instruction conditions; otherwise 30.2.3 applies.
gaps.finding_reason: All clause 30.2 routes are marked N/A and the fire-test table is empty, although an insulating bushing is listed; the conditions for selecting the applicable route are not established.
gaps.required_action: Establish the applicable clause 30.2 route and provide the required component or material evidence.

gaps.normative_requirement: The applicable clearance and creepage requirements are in Part 1, which was not supplied.
gaps.finding_reason: The clearance table records a 500 V impulse basis and the basic creepage assessment uses the ≤50 V row, without establishing their applicability to the declared 220–240 V model.
gaps.required_action: Reassess and document the insulation distances using the verified circuit voltages and applicable Part 1 requirements.

gaps.normative_requirement: A report must provide reliable attribution of its evidence; a specific report-identification requirement is not present in the supplied particular part.
gaps.finding_reason: PDF page 86 carries report number EN200622010S rather than EN201222034S, raising uncertainty about attribution of the creepage-table continuation.
gaps.required_action: Obtain a laboratory-issued corrected report with verified page attribution and complete numbering.

gaps.normative_requirement: Submersible pumps are not subjected to the clause 22.101 static-pressure test.
gaps.finding_reason: The report records a pass for the static-pressure test despite identifying the product as submersible and reproducing the exclusion.
gaps.required_action: Correct the clause disposition and clarify whether the recorded test relates to the declared sample.

final_summary.evaluation_conclusion: Compliance of SPC55068 cannot be determined from this report. The conflicting sample identity and ratings invalidate reliance on the reported pass results for the declared product; the remaining marking, immersion, cord and fire-resistance evidence must also be resolved.
final_summary.recommended_action: Obtain an authenticated, corrected or replacement report for SPC55068 with applicable test evidence and supply the relevant Part 1 and A11 amendment before certification proceeds.
